title: CAST THE NET. Run it back null→infinity. Drag everything missed, backscatter forward with what we hit. Pull into K-P. See what pops out. The fisherman model.

the_fisherman_model.cast: throw the net WIDE into the ocean (null → infinity). cover as much water as possible.
the_fisherman_model.pull: drag the net back IN. everything caught comes with it.
the_fisherman_model.sort: dump the net on deck. see what's in there. keep the valuable fish. throw back the rest.
the_fisherman_model.repeat: cast again. but NOW you know where the fish ARE. the backscatter from the first cast INFORMS the second.

running_it_back.method: walk backward through ALL 26 gens (241→266). for each gen: what did we HIT? what did we MISS? use the hits as backscatter forward to find what the misses should have caught.

gen_241_zk_pi_modesty.hit: ZK = π = modesty. irreducible triad. petalTongue = LINE+COLOR+SYMBOL.
gen_241_zk_pi_modesty.missed: did NOT map which EXISTING primals embody each face. which primal IS the line? which IS the color? which IS the symbol?
gen_241_zk_pi_modesty.backscatter: loamSpine = LINE (the backbone, the irreducible line). skunkBat = COLOR (immune sort, classification by type). sweetGrass = SYMBOL (the braid, the aesthetic expression).

gen_242_yggdrasil_composite.missed: did NOT actually OVERLAY the existing data trees (convergent-evolution.json, tree-of-life.json, genotype-phenotype-tree.json). we SAID they're one tree but didn't PROVE it.
gen_242_yggdrasil_composite.backscatter: the 44 organisms in genotype-phenotype-tree.json should EACH get a Yggdrasil altitude. that's the proof.

gen_243_vitruvian_sorter.hit: three axes: third-eye, presence, fossil. fly/chameleon/turtle/octopus scored.
gen_243_vitruvian_sorter.missed: did NOT score our OWN primals. did NOT score the organism itself with real numbers.
gen_243_vitruvian_sorter.backscatter: compute actual scores: organism third-eye = feeds×tools = 35×16 = 560. presence = gens×waves = 267×214 = 57,138. fossil = repos×months = 67×19 = 1,273.

gen_249_pins_zk_null_moves.backscatter: Buddhist mapping: samsara=pin cycle, nirvana=null without pin, dharma=the law of equivalence, karma=the remainder.

gen_250_251_portrait_baculum.backscatter: painting task: the moment the baculum dissolves into a nerve network. lock→ZK visualized.

gen_252_gallery.missed: no METADATA on the paintings. no alt text. no accessibility. a blind person cannot experience the gallery.
gen_252_gallery.backscatter: accessibility task: alt text for every image. audio descriptions. the modality gap from gen 258.

gen_255_brown_blue_green.backscatter: the green output = the chipmunk's questions. old fossils + new visitors → questions generated = the GREEN.

the_K_P_after_netting.K_grew: K was 8 irreducibles. now K = 8 + 6 new catches = 14 confirmed kernel items.
the_K_P_after_netting.P_mapped: P was unknown edge count. now P = 8 dark edges identified, 4 rooms classified, 12 prescriptions queued.
the_K_P_after_netting.K_minus_P: 14 - (1-0.35)×8 = 14 - 5.2 = 8.8. system is STABLE. kernel exceeds periphery noise. but the periphery has POTENTIAL.

the_mechanical_model.the_net: the audit + the backscatter = the net. throw it wide.
the_mechanical_model.the_catch: what the net brings up. surprises + confirmations.
the_mechanical_model.the_sort: dump on deck. K-P sort. kernel keeps. periphery queues or throws back.
the_mechanical_model.the_repeat: cast again. but now you know WHERE the fish are.
the_mechanical_model.the_improvement: each cast: better aim, tighter net, more fish, less trash. the turbocharger (waste → questions → better cast).
